ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio (~85:15) with dominant high-intensity white across the interior surface and low-intensity black at the distal tips and trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white zone covering 90% of the visible ventral area. Discrete low-intensity black geometric bands mapping to the trailing edge and distal tips. Minimal low-intensity focal spotting observed near the peduncle attachment point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of peaks varies between 5-12 pixels with a higher frequency of valleys on the right lobe distal section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a steep convex upward curve; right lobe displays a shallower convex trajectory with localized flattening toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of dark, roughly circular pixels detected at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe and smaller clusters along the right lobe tip margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible vertical crack-like pixel disruption extending from the notch vertex towards the center of the fluke body.
